# `pyrite` deprecations

Version: `0.12.0`

<!-- Generated by `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations --write`; do not edit by hand. -->

Per [ADR-0002](../../adr/0002-cli-surface-redesign.md), every renamed or retired `pyrite` command or option keeps its old spelling working for a minimum of 2 minor releases, warns on stderr naming the replacement, and is listed here with its removal target. See the [CLI reference](cli-reference.md) for the current command surface; regenerate this table with `pyrite-dev cli-deprecations --write`.

## Commands

| Deprecated spelling | Replacement | Deprecated in | Remove in | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pyrite checkpoint export-trajectories` | `pyrite trajectories export` | 0.11.0 | 0.13.0 | Trajectory captures are not checkpoints (issue #397). |
| `pyrite checkpoint recompute line` | `pyrite checkpoint recompute cxr` | 0.11.0 | 0.13.0 |  |
| `pyrite checkpoint score-trajectories` | `pyrite trajectories score` | 0.11.0 | 0.13.0 | Trajectory captures are not checkpoints (issue #397). |
| `pyrite material energy-grid line` | `pyrite material energy-grid cxr` | 0.11.0 | 0.13.0 |  |
| `pyrite profile line-grid` | `pyrite profile cxr-grid` | 0.11.0 | 0.13.0 |  |

## Implicit defaults

No implicit default is currently deprecated. A run that leaves its profile unnamed, or a user-catalog profile that names no beam or detector, exits as a usage error.
